name: Global Link Management Inc.
summary: Global Link Management Inc. operates as a real estate solution company in Japan. The company engages in investment, design, development, sales, and management of mansions. The company is also involved in management of properties and rental management business. It engages in real estate building, land planning, revitalization and development business. The company constructs hotels, office buildings, and commercial facilities. Global Link Management Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
